name: Lonely_1
short_caption: The robot slightly lowers its head and tilts it sideways with a subtle droop in its posture.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and slowly lowers its head while tilting it slightly to the left side. Its shoulders and arms remain mostly still, hanging slightly looser than before, conveying a slumped or dejected posture. It holds this lowered, tilted head position for a few seconds before slowly raising its head back to the level, forward-facing neutral position.
